pairs.note:
4:42 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 70 degrees, relative humidity 53 percent, barometer 30.00 inches, adjusted altitude 2,281 feet, track temperature 92 degrees.

Todd is 5 - 3 against Wilkerson in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other in a final round.

Todd gets out of the gate first and starts pulling away. Wilkerson starts making up ground at the 330 foot mark, then Todd is able to pull away and take the stripe for the win.

J.R. Todd's incremental margins: 60ft(0.034), 330 ft(0.053), 660ft(0.048).  MOV: 0.0603 seconds (approximately 28 feet).

With the win Todd wins the national championship, his 25th career win, the third of the year, and the national championship double-up for the Kalitta team.
